title: The NG911 Email: Planned FCC Meetings, No Proven Access Chain
scope: Source-locked reconstruction of the Nov. 23, 2015 Reporty/NG911 email thread, distinguishing public information sharing and prospective outreach from completed FCC access or later-customer causality.

sources.supports: Epstein forwards Wheeler article URL; Barak reports Barcelona activity, prospective Wheeler and Schulzrinne contacts, advisory-board intent and investor interest.
sources.limit: Statements about prior meetings are Barak's account; prospective language does not prove completion.

sources.supports: Bounded corpus search for follow-up/meeting completion and later-customer causal bridge.

open_questions: Whether a Wheeler meeting was scheduled or completed after Nov. 23, 2015.
Whether the planned Nov. 24 Schulzrinne meeting occurred.
Whether Schulzrinne ever accepted an advisory role with Reporty/Carbyne.
Who, if anyone, introduced Reporty to Wheeler or Schulzrinne.
Whether any later U.S. customer referral can be source-linked to the 2015 contacts.
not_established: That Epstein introduced Reporty or Barak to Wheeler or Schulzrinne.
That the Wheeler or Schulzrinne meetings occurred.
Improper government influence, favoritism, endorsement or lobbying success.
A causal path from the Nov. 2015 email to the 2018 Fayette County or Ocean County deployments.
